product.name: USB-C Desktop Crumb Vacuum
product.description: A small rechargeable vacuum intended for loose crumbs and eraser shavings on dry desk surfaces.

script_facts: This is a small rechargeable vacuum for loose crumbs and eraser shavings on dry desk surfaces.
The collection bin must be emptied manually.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim a deep clean, instant result, or exact suction power.
Do not claim that the vacuum handles liquids, embedded dirt, or every surface.
Do not claim that it sanitizes, disinfects, or removes allergens.
Do not infer battery runtime or charging speed.
editorial_direction: Lead with loose crumbs or eraser shavings interrupting a clean desk setup.
Describe only pickup of loose dry debris.
Show the two nozzle choices and manual-empty bin as concrete mechanisms.
Keep the limitation to dry desk surfaces explicit when relevant.
Do not mention a brand, price, rating, or affiliate details.
